name: humor
quote: I liked the joke about the witch!
description: Delight driven by unusual social tension or connection that is perceived as clever and harmless to the self and other important people.
perceptions: Something happened to cause unusual tension or connection, often social
The event is considered clever or harmless.

guidance.description: Every person likes to stay around people who make them laugh. Being funny is one of the most sought-after qualities.

opposites: failed humor can go in many directions

variations.name: slapstick humor
variations.description: Slapstick humor is physical, e.g. someone tripping but not getting hurt.
perceptions: A physical accident or minor attack happened to cause unusual tension.
The event is considered clever or harmless.

variations.name: verbal humor
variations.description: Verbal humor can be jokes, puns, stories, insults, witty observations, etc.
perceptions: Something is said that causes unusual tension or connection, often social
The statement is considered clever or harmless.

variations.name: teasing
variations.description: Teasing is a gently irritating social interaction that can be verbal or physical. Children enjoy teasing and tickling, as do chimpanzees.
perceptions: A physical incident or minor irritation is aimed at getting attention and causing unusual tension.

variations.name: repetitive humor
variations.description: Surprise can be a factor in finding something funny, but old favorite jokes can still amuse.
perceptions: Something happened that repeats an uncommon tension or connection.
The event is considered clever or harmless.

variations.name: silly humor
variations.description: Attempts at humor that seem obvious, over-the-top, or cringingly manufactured.
perceptions: Something unusual and often childlike happened that creates an uncommon tension.

variations.name: gross humor
variations.description: Attempts at humor that involve bodily fluids or noises that make young kids giggle.
perceptions: Something considered rude happened that creates an uncommon tension.

commentaries.quote: Not everyone finds every kind of humor funny.
Laughter doesn't always mean something is funny. It can also be a social signal that there's some kind of tension that the laugher hopes will resolve harmlessly.
Failed humor can be experienced in many ways, including: weird, gross, concern, cringe, embarrassment, disagreement, disappointment, humiliation, anger, and anxiety.
Humor played a multifaceted role in human evolution, contributing to social bonding, mate selection, cognitive development, emotional regulation, and conflict resolution.
